Dear Alice,

We are now opening our Interest Check for Jolly Lads Holiday Market, a Christmas art market by Coniglio 🎄✨

This holiday bazaar is open to artists and small business owners who wish to showcase their work in a festive, community-driven space. Please note that food merchants will not be accommodated.

The form will help us gauge artist participation and expected foot traffic. Attendees are also encouraged to answer so we can better plan the event.

📅 Date: TBA
📍 Venue: Mabuhay Tea House, Manila
🗓 Interest Check closes on April 20

🔗 Form: https://t.co/bUilkgNXr2

Follow the rabbit, Alice 🐇✨

With love,
Coniglio

**This is a fan-organized, non-profit event and is not affiliated with Infold or their official game Love And Deepspace in any way.

data.raw_text:
Pormal nang ibinigay ng Quezon City Government sa Bureau of Fire Protection - Quezon City Fire District ang mga kagamitan laban sa sunog.

Pinangunahan ni Mayor Joy Belmonte ang ceremonial turnover ng mga equipment kay QC Fire Marshal FSSupt. Roberto Samillano Jr.

Ibinigay ng lokal na pamahalaan sa QCFD ang mga sumusunod na kagamitan:
- 5 motorcycle units
- 7 drones
- 28 fire nozzles
- 3 smoke ejectors
- 2 ionization detectors
